fields.title: Zoiko Mobile UK Unveils New Website & Expands eSIM Access for a Faster, Simpler Inclusive Experience
fields.excerpt: Zoiko Mobile UK Unveils New Website & Expands eSIM Access for a Faster, Simpler Inclusive Experience LONDON – Nov. 17,...
fields.intro:
Zoiko Mobile UK today announced the launch of its newly rebuilt website together with full eSIM availability across all plans. This upgrade strengthens the company's mission to deliver a faster, simpler and more inclusive digital experience for customers across the United Kingdom.

Developed using direct customer feedback, the new platform introduces improvements in speed, usability, accessibility and journey clarity — positioning Zoiko Mobile UK as a modern and customer-focused challenger network.
fields.about: Zoiko Mobile UK is a customer-focused mobile network offering prepaid, postpaid, business, travel and eSIM services with nationwide coverage. Built on simplicity, transparency and inclusive connectivity, Zoiko Mobile UK serves diverse communities including animal lovers, students, essential workers, gig-economy workers and small businesses.

fields.heading: A Faster, Modernised and Mobile-First Customer Journey
bullets: Instant eSIM activation across all plans
Simplified checkout journey with fewer steps
Clearer plan comparison with transparent pricing and features
Mobile-first interface optimised for customers browsing on their phones
Accessibility improvements including screen reader support and high-contrast mode

fields.heading: Serving a Broad and Diverse UK Community
fields.body: ["Animal lovers and wildlife supporters", "Aspiring musicians, creators and performers", "Animal charities and community organisations", "Small businesses and sole traders", "Essential Workers including NHS staff, carers, postal and retail teams", "Households eligible for Social Tariff plans", "Students, travellers and short-term visitors", "Gig workers, delivery riders and mobile professionals"]

fields.heading: Looking Ahead
fields.body: ["Enhanced tools and features for business and fleet customers", "Improved self-service account management", "Greater digital automation across support workflows", "Ongoing refinements to eSIM provisioning and activation reliability", "Strengthened SIM security, identity verification and fraud controls"]

fields.quote: This relaunch is about reducing friction and putting our customers first. We aim to be the UK's most straightforward network — simple plans, transparent pricing, instant eSIMs and a journey built around real customer needse
fields.author: Marcel Jones

fields.quote: ustomers showed us the pain points, and we rebuilt the platform around that insight. The new site is faster, clearer and significantly more accessible.
fields.author: Amira Benn
